+    keep = (improvement_no_call > tau_filter) & (improvement_call_only > 0)
+    # Margin is the improvement over no-call minus tau
+    margin = improvement_no_call - tau_filter
+    return keep, margin.astype(np.float64)

# Compute improvement over no-call and over call-only
    improvement_no_call = np.sum(logp_no_call - logp_with_result, axis=1)
    improvement_call_only = np.sum(logp_call_only - logp_with_result, axis=1)
    # Both improvements must exceed tau_filter
    keep = (improvement_no_call > tau_filter) & (improvement_call_only > tau_filter)
    # Margin is the improvement over no-call minus tau (a finite floating margin)
    margin = improvement_no_call - tau_filter
    return keep, margin.astype(np.float64)
